card.plain_headline: FX options expiries could move currency pairs
card.what_happened: Large currency option contracts expiring on Tuesday could influence trading activity and potentially cause price movements in specific currency pairs. Traders will be watching these expiries closely.
card.what_happened_verbose: On Tuesday, significant volumes of currency options contracts are set to expire. Options are financial derivatives that give the buyer the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a currency at a specific price (the strike price) before a certain date. When large amounts of these contracts expire, it can sometimes lead to increased trading volume as market participants adjust their positions, potentially causing price volatility in the affected currency pairs.
